main_text.p: Jes.60.21. vel Plantarum mearum: Scribitur enim per ו, sed legitur juxta Maforethas, מַטָּעַי.

נטף Stillavit, Deftillavit: Præterit. נָטְפוּ מַיִם Stillaverunt aquas, Judicum 5.4. Partic.præsens, נוֹטְפוֹת Stillantia, Cant.5.13. Futur. תִּטֹּף מִלְּתִי Stillabit sermo meus, Job.29.22. &c. Hiph. Præteritum, וְהִטִּיפוּ Et stillabunt, Amos 9.13. Partic.præsens, מַטִּיף Stillans, vel Stillator, quo Propheta illic intelligitur, Mich.2. v.11. Imper. וְהַטִּיף Et stilla, vel, Fac ut stillet, id est, prophetet, Ezech.21.2. Futur. אַטִּיף Stillabo, id est, prophetabo, prophetiam eloquar, Mich.2.11. &c.
נָטָף m. Stacte, Stilla, Exod.30.34. Plur.Conftr. נִטְפֵי מַיִם Stillæ aquarum, Job.36.27.

נְטִיפוֹת f. Myrothecidia, Jud.8.26. quasi Stillatoria, aut Guttatoria dicas; Vascula scil. aurea, in quibus ponebatur נָטָף Stacte aut Balsamum, juxta Kimchium & Rab.Levi. Et defectivè, נְטִפוֹת, Jesa.3.19. Quidam, Catenulas, Torques exponunt.
נָטַר Custodivit, Servavit, Asservavit: Præterit. נָטַרְתִּי Custodivi, Cant.1.6. &c. Chald. Præter. נְטַר Servavi, Dan.7.28.
מִטְרָה f. Custodia, Carcer, Jer.32.2. Item Scopus, quasi Observationem dicas: לְמִטְרָה In scopum, Job.16.12. Et cum א loco He, כְּמִטְרָא [?] Ut scopum, Threni.3.12.

נָטַשׁ Dimisit, Deseruit, Permisit, Omisit: Et quandoque intransitivè, Extendit, Expandit: Diffudit se: Præteritum, נָטַשׁ אָבִיךָ Omisit pater tuus, 1.Sam.10.2. &c. Partic. Præter. נְטוּשִׁים Dimissi, Diffusi, Diffusi erant, 1.Sam.30.16. Fœm. חֶרֶב נְטוּשָׁה Gladii dimissi, Extensi, Jes.21.15. Fut. יִטֹּשׁ Deseres, 1.Sam.12.22. וַיִּטֹּשׁ Et extendit se, Diffudit se, 1.Sam.4.2. Niph. Præt. נִטְּשׁוּ Extenderunt se, Jes.16.8. נִטְשָׁה Deserta erit, Amos 5. v.2. Futur,

page.notes: Several Hebrew forms are copied from a small, dense print and may be misread; the uncertain one is marked [?]. The Latin abbreviation "Conftr." and the printed "Diffusi" repetition in the Pars. Praeter. entry are reproduced as printed, not corrected. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout, including in book abbreviations (Jes., Ief. at top). The entry ends mid-sentence at "Futur," and continues on the next page.
